Bangladesh statement

Meeting of the Indian High Commissioner with the Prime Minister’s Advisor on Foreign Affairs

Dhaka, 03 August 2026;

The newly appointed Indian High Commissioner to Dhaka, Dinesh Trivedi, paid a courtesy call on the Prime Minister’s Advisor on Foreign Affairs, Humayun Kabir, on Monday afternoon at the Prime Minister’s Office in Tejgaon.

During the meeting, various aspects of the existing bilateral relations between Bangladesh and India, as well as issues of mutual interest, were discussed. They expressed optimism about further strengthening and advancing the bilateral relations on the basis of mutual respect, trust, and shared interests.

The news circulating on social media that the fugitive Sheikh Hasina may deliver a public speech on 05 August came up in the discussion.

In this regard, the Foreign Affairs Advisor informed the High Commissioner that Bangladesh expects India’s cooperation to ensure that no person belonging to organisations whose activities are banned, including the fugitive Sheikh Hasina, can use Indian territory to deliver political speeches or carry out any activities aimed at creating instability inside Bangladesh. He noted that such activities could harm the positive progress of bilateral relations.

The Indian High Commissioner assured that he would duly consider the matter, make the necessary inquiries, and remain vigilant on this issue.
